transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been experiencing a lot of severe stress and distress after a traumatic event that happened about a week ago. I just haven't been able to feel normal since then, so I decided I needed to seek some help.
Since the traumatic event, have you been having things like unwanted memories or nightmares, feeling on edge, avoiding reminders, or feeling detached or unreal? Which of these have you noticed?

I've been actively avoiding any thoughts, memories, or places that remind me of what happened. I also feel incredibly detached, like I'm watching myself from the outside, and my surroundings often feel completely unreal or dreamlike. I haven't really had nightmares or felt on edge, though.
Just to clarify, did these symptoms start within the past month after the trauma, or have they lasted for more than a month?
They started right after the event occurred, which was just about a week ago. So, it has only been going on for about a week now.
Have these symptoms been severe enough to interfere with your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how it's affecting my daily life because I've just been so completely overwhelmed by these feelings themselves.
Since this started, have you missed work or school, pulled away from people, or had trouble keeping up with basic daily tasks?

I haven't missed work or struggled with basic daily tasks, but I have definitely been pulling away from people. I'm actively avoiding social situations, certain places, and conversations because they remind me too much of what happened and make me incredibly distressed.
Have you had any unwanted memories, flashbacks, or distressing dreams about what happened, even if they’re brief or only happen sometimes?
No, I haven't had any flashbacks, unwanted memories, or distressing dreams about what happened. It actually feels more like my mind is trying to completely block it all out rather than replaying it.
Since the event, have you been feeling jumpy, unusually watchful, irritable, or had trouble sleeping or concentrating?
No, I haven't really experienced any of those issues since the event. I haven't been feeling jumpy or irritable, and my sleep and concentration have been okay.
When you feel detached or like things are unreal, does it feel like you’re outside yourself or that the world around you isn’t real, and how often has that been happening?

Yes, it feels exactly like that. I often feel detached from my own body, as if I'm an outside observer watching myself, and other times my surroundings feel completely unreal or dreamlike. I've been experiencing both of these unsettling sensations quite frequently over the past week.
Since the event, have you been feeling persistently unable to experience positive emotions, like happiness, closeness, or satisfaction?
I haven't really noticed that, to be honest. I'm not sure if my ability to feel positive emotions has changed since the event.
Are there important parts of what happened that you still can’t remember, beyond just not wanting to think about it?

Yes, that's true. I can remember some parts of the event clearly, but there are specific, important moments that are just a complete blank. No matter how hard I try to piece it together, I simply can't recall those gaps.

Symptoms began immediately after the trauma and remain within the first month, supporting Acute Stress Disorder rather than PTSD.
